_about: Hand-checked corrections applied by tools/build_catalog.py after the merge (see apply_overrides).
rules: match records by case-insensitive regex on fields ('a|b' tries either field); applied in order.
readings / assignments: entries keyed by final catalog id; applied after the rules.
Each entry may 'set' fields, rewrite notes with 'notes_sub' ([regex, replacement]), and append a 'note'.
License rule: when sources disagree, record the most restrictive license and keep the others in notes.
Evidence for every change below was gathered on 2026-10-17; see research/cleanup_report.md.

rules.name: writing-spaces-1-2-chapters-strictest
notes_sub: CC BY-NC-SA: may be adapted/remixed for noncommercial use if adaptations carry the same license\.\s*
rules.note: License check 2026-10-17: recorded CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 US, the most restrictive statement (volume copyright page in the PDF: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 US 'unless otherwise stated'; WAC Clearinghouse volume page, rechecked today: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 'unless otherwise stated'). The chapter footnote's CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US is kept only as this note.
